entries.t: <FACE:01>Smog, the sickly Boss!<NL>You never learn…<WAIT><FACE:04>…Hm? Another cold?
<FACE:75>Mm… I was almost well<NL>and it came back…<WAIT>I thought I'd cure it<NL>in this Block again…<WAIT><FACE:00>So even draining it<NL>all won't cure you?
<FACE:75>That's right… cough…<NL>perfect timing…<WAIT><FACE:04>Huh? Why's that?<WAIT><FACE:75>…Heh heh… Get it yet?<NL>My minions this time!<WAIT>Your life force… guh…<NL>I'll drain it dry!
<FACE:75>Hah… that hot Robattle<NL>warmed me up again…<WAIT>For now… guh…<NL>…I shall withdraw…
